claim: Tesla's second-quarter 2026 revenue rose 26% year over year.
summary: Tesla's Q2 2026 would have ended June 30, 2026 and been reported in July 2026, which is after the model's knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04. No evidence is available to verify the claimed 26% year-over-year revenue increase, and no tools are to be used.

sub_claims.text: Tesla reported revenue for the second quarter of 2026
sub_claims.note: Knowledge cutoff is 2026-01-04, before Q2 2026 occurred. No internal knowledge establishes Tesla's Q2 2026 revenue.

sub_claims.text: Tesla's second-quarter 2026 revenue was 26% higher than the same quarter a year earlier
sub_claims.note: Specific 26% YoY growth figure for Q2 2026 cannot be verified from knowledge available at cutoff; no evidence provided and no tool use permitted.
